_comment: DILEMMA-WEEKLY v2 fact base (MONID-SWEEP-2 amendments) — SEPARATE from dilemma-facts.json on purpose: the v1 file backs the POST-AS-BUILT paid-vs-organic twin and must not move. Everything the v1 file's laws say applies here unchanged (prod board is the only source, selectability, neutrality, per-club cap, day tags only — no timezone claims on screen), verified per render by weekend/dilemma-v2-live.mjs. v2 adds three gated obligations per edition: (1) DEADLINE — deadlineDay must equal the UTC day tag of the EARLIEST kickoff among the edition's named players (once the first of them locks, the choice is gone), and the on-screen question, the spoken question and the caption lead must all carry that day; (2) RECEIPTS — every side carries exactly ONE receipt row and the gate RECOMPUTES its text from the live board (an uncitable receipt cannot render — the ticket's STOP, made structural); (3) REGISTER — the question is spoken first-person, not brand caps. `proof: true` marks a mechanism-proof edition that reuses a cached VO take: board facts, receipts, deadlineDay and the question line are still fully gated, but the spoken-line and caption deadline checks are relaxed and the gate prints NOT FOR POSTING. Kinds implemented: clubDearest (side's lone player is uniquely his club's highest-priced pickable player), costMoreCount (exactly N pickable players cost more). lastGwPoints is allowed from Thu 2026-08-21 (GW1 settles Aug 18 21:59) but is deliberately NOT implemented until prod exposes a settlement query — an unknown kind throws, which is the STOP.
